records.jp: ここは…………
records.en_original: This place...
records.en_auxiliary: This place...
records.en: This place...

records.jp: きらら？
records.en_original: Kirara?
records.en_auxiliary: Kirara?
records.en: Kirara?

records.jp: ……お告げの間
records.en_original: The prophecy room.
records.en_auxiliary: The prophecy room.
records.en: The prophecy room.

records.jp: ここは、きららが村の人たちと<CR>“神託の儀式”をするための場所だった
records.en_original: This is where the people from the village would come to perform the Oracle's ritual.
records.en_auxiliary: This is where the people from the village would come to perform the Oracle's ritual.
records.en: This was the place where Kirara and the villagers<CR>performed the 'Oracle Ritual.'

records.jp: し、神託の儀式……
records.en_original: The Oracle's ritual...
records.en_auxiliary: The Oracle's ritual...
records.en: Th-the Oracle Ritual...

records.jp: そこで神からの言葉を伝える。<CR>それが、あの頃のきららの役目だった
records.en_original: My role was to deliver the words of god.
records.en_auxiliary: My role was to deliver the words of god.
records.en: Kirara relayed the words of the Divine here.<CR>That was Kirara's role back then.

records.jp: でも、あの日は違って――
records.en_original: But that day, things were different...
records.en_auxiliary: But that day, things were different...
records.en: But that day, things were different...

records.jp: 祠のツボが割れた！？
records.en_original: Someone broke the urn?!
records.en_auxiliary: Someone broke the urn?!
records.en: The urn in the shrine broke?!

records.jp: ええ……それで長老たちが怒ってしまって<CR>手が付けられません……
records.en_original: Yes... The Elders are very upset. We're having a hard time trying to calm them down.
records.en_auxiliary: Yes... The Elders are very upset. We're having a hard time trying to calm them down.
records.en: Yes... The elders are furious,<CR>and there is no calming them down...

records.jp: 代々大事にしてきた村の宝ですからね……
records.en_original: It is the village heirloom, after all.
records.en_auxiliary: It is the village heirloom, after all.
records.en: It is a village treasure passed down for generations...

records.jp: しかも、祠からケイタとユカが出てきたのを<CR>見たという人が複数いるんです
records.en_original: To make matters worse, multiple witnesses say they saw Keita and Yuka leaving the shrine.
records.en_auxiliary: To make matters worse, multiple witnesses say they saw Keita and Yuka leaving the shrine.
records.en: Moreover, several people claim they saw Keita and Yuka<CR>coming out of the shrine.

records.jp: じゃあ、割ったのは二人のどちらかということですか
records.en_original: Then it's likely one of them broke the urn.
records.en_auxiliary: Then it's likely one of them broke the urn.
records.en: Then one of the two of them broke it?

records.jp: 神託でツボが割れることを予見できなかったのかと<CR>いう声もありまして……
records.en_original: Some have even been saying it's the oracle's fault for not predicting it.
records.en_auxiliary: Some have even been saying it's the oracle's fault for not predicting it.
records.en: Some are also asking why the oracle<CR>could not foresee that the urn would break...

records.jp: まいったな……神託か……
records.en_original: The oracle's fault? Unfortunate...
records.en_auxiliary: The oracle's fault? Unfortunate...
records.en: This is bad... The oracle, huh...

records.jp: ……むしろ、ツボを割るべきだと神託があったことに<CR>するのはどうでしょう？
records.en_original: ...What if we told them the oracle demanded we break the urn?
records.en_auxiliary: ...What if we told them the oracle demanded we break the urn?
records.en: ...What if we say there was an oracle commanding us<CR>to break the urn?

records.jp: 馬鹿言わないでください！<CR>相談なしに割ったことを許すはずがありません！
records.en_original: That's a terrible idea! They'd never forgive you for not having consulted them first.
records.en_auxiliary: That's a terrible idea! They'd never forgive you for not having consulted them first.
records.en: Do not be ridiculous!<CR>They would never forgive you for breaking it without consulting them!

records.jp: 高齢化が進むこの村で長老たちを敵に回したら、<CR>いくら神託があれどあなた方は終わりです！
records.en_original: With the amount of elders in our village, you're finished if you anger them! Even with your oracle!
records.en_auxiliary: With the amount of elders in our village, you're finished if you anger them! Even with your oracle!
records.en: In this aging village, if you make enemies of the elders,<CR>you are finished no matter how powerful the oracle!

records.jp: むう……
records.en_original: Hm...
records.en_auxiliary: Hm...
records.en: Hm...

records.jp: ……ユカがやったことにしましょう
records.en_original: ...We must tell them it was Yuka.
records.en_auxiliary: ...We must tell them it was Yuka.
records.en: ...Let's say Yuka did it.

records.en_original: What?
records.en_auxiliary: What?
records.en: What?

records.jp: ケイタがやったとなれば私の地位も危うい。<CR>すると議会への口添えもできなくなります
records.en_original: If Keita is blamed for this, my status and influence on the assembly would be gone.
records.en_auxiliary: If Keita is blamed for this, my status and influence on the assembly would be gone.
records.en: If Keita is blamed, my own position will be in danger.<CR>Then I will no longer be able to put in a word with the assembly.

records.jp: あなたの県知事選で、協力できなくなるんです。<CR>久野さん、ひとつここはお互いのために……
records.en_original: In other words, I wouldn't be able to support you in the elections. It's for the best.
records.en_auxiliary: In other words, I wouldn't be able to support you in the elections. It's for the best.
records.en: I will be unable to help you in the gubernatorial election.<CR>Kuno-san, for both our sakes...

records.jp: きらら……わかってるな？<CR>ツボはユカが――
records.en_original: Kirara... You understand, don't you? You must tell them it was Yuka.
records.en_auxiliary: Kirara... You understand, don't you? You must tell them it was Yuka.
records.en: Kirara... You understand, don't you?<CR>The one who broke the urn was Yuka—

records.jp: 二人の話を聞いたら、ユカは無理やり連れ回された<CR>だけで、ツボを割った犯人はケイタだとわかった
records.en_original: When I asked them about it, they said that Keita was the one who broke it, and that he had dragged Yuka along with him.
records.en_auxiliary: When I asked them about it, they said that Keita was the one who broke it, and that he had dragged Yuka along with him.
records.en: After hearing both of them, Kirara learned that Yuka had only been<CR>dragged along against her will, and Keita had broken the urn.

records.jp: でも、ケイタは……村長の息子。<CR>パパは、村長との関係を守るために――
records.en_original: But Keita was the Mayor's son, and my dad had to protect his relationship with the Mayor.
records.en_auxiliary: But Keita was the Mayor's son, and my dad had to protect his relationship with the Mayor.
records.en: But Keita was the mayor's son.<CR>Papa wanted to protect his relationship with the mayor—

records.jp: そんな……
records.en_original: No way...
records.en_auxiliary: No way...
records.en: No way...

records.jp: 酷くない？　罪を擦り付けるってことでしょ？
records.en_original: That's horrible. They wanted you to blame an innocent girl?
records.en_auxiliary: That's horrible. They wanted you to blame an innocent girl?
records.en: Isn't that awful? They were going to pin the blame on her, right?

records.jp: それで、きららはどうしたの……？
records.en_original: What did you do, Kirara?
records.en_auxiliary: What did you do, Kirara?
records.en: What did you do, Kirara?

records.jp: きららは……
records.en: Kirara...

records.jp: 皆さん、本日はお忙しいところ、<CR>お集まりいただきありがとうございます
records.en_original: Ladies and gentlemen, I appreciate you all taking the time to gather with us today.
records.en_auxiliary: Ladies and gentlemen, I appreciate you all taking the time to gather with us today.
records.en: Thank you all for taking the time<CR>to gather here today.

records.jp: 今日は、わが娘きららが、ツボを割った犯人に関して<CR>非常に重要な神託を受けたということで、ご報告です
records.en_original: I hereby inform you that my daughter, Kirara, has received an important vision regarding the urn.
records.en_auxiliary: I hereby inform you that my daughter, Kirara, has received an important vision regarding the urn.
records.en: My daughter Kirara has received a crucial oracle<CR>concerning the culprit who broke the urn, and will report it now.

records.jp: さあ、きらら
records.en_original: Go on, Kirara.
records.en_auxiliary: Go on, Kirara.
records.en: Go on, Kirara.

records.jp: 神託を
records.en_original: Tell them.
records.en_auxiliary: Tell them.
records.en: The oracle.

records.jp: きららは……
records.en: Kirara...

records.jp: きららは――――
records.en: Kirara—

records.jp: ！！　モンスターだ……！
records.en_original: Watch out! A demon!
records.en_auxiliary: Watch out! A demon!
records.en: A monster...!

records.jp: しかも、かなり大きいよ！
records.en_original: A big one, too!
records.en_auxiliary: A big one, too!
records.en: A big one, too!

records.jp: 久野さん！　下がって！
records.en_original: Kuno! Get back!
records.en_auxiliary: Kuno! Get back!
records.en: Kuno-san! Get back!

records.jp: ――みんな
records.en_original: I—
records.en_auxiliary: I—
records.en: Everyone—

records.jp: 大丈夫だよ、きららは待ってて
records.en_original: It'll be fine. You just wait there.
records.en_auxiliary: It'll be fine. You just wait there.
records.en: It'll be fine. You just wait there.

records.jp: きららちゃんは病み上がりなんだから、<CR>無理しちゃだめなのです
records.en_original: You've still only just woken up, we don't want you exhausting yourself.
records.en_auxiliary: You've still only just woken up, we don't want you exhausting yourself.
records.en: You have only just recovered, Kirara-chan,<CR>so you must not push yourself.

records.jp: 安心してください。すぐに倒して、<CR>久野さんの思い出、取り戻します！
records.en_original: Don't worry. We'll take care of this real quick and get your memory back!
records.en_auxiliary: Don't worry. We'll take care of this real quick and get your memory back!
records.en: Do not worry. We will defeat it quickly<CR>and recover your memories, Kuno-san!

records.jp: ……ありがとう
records.en_original: ...Thank you.
records.en_auxiliary: ...Thank you.
records.en: ...Thank you.

records.jp: きららの思い出を、よろしく
records.en_original: I leave it to you.
records.en_auxiliary: I leave it to you.
records.en: Kirara's memories are in your hands.

records.jp: よっしゃ、任されたっ！
records.en_original: All right! We got this!
records.en_auxiliary: All right! We got this!
records.en: All right! We got this!
